name: Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 41

criteria.description: Progressive cerebellar ataxia with gait disturbance and limb incoordination
Identification of pathogenic variants in the FAT2 gene
Exclusion of other known causes of hereditary and acquired ataxias
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive cerebellar ataxia plus genetic confirmation of FAT2 mutation and exclusion of other ataxias
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for definitive diagnosis due to phenotypic overlap with other SCAs.

laboratory: Exclusion of metabolic causes of ataxia
imaging: MRI showing cerebellar atrophy predominantly affecting the vermis and hemispheres
other: Electromyography may show mild peripheral neuropathy

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of prominent pyramidal signs and dystonia
CAG repeat expansion in ATXN3 gene
Early onset with cardiomyopathy and diabetes mellitus
GAA repeat expansion in FXN gene

redFlags: Rapid progression of ataxia over weeks to months
Presence of systemic symptoms such as weight loss or fever
Onset before age 10 or after age 70
references: Synofzik M, et al. FAT2 mutations cause spinocerebellar ataxia type 41. Brain. 2019.
